verdict.rationale: Snowflake's Time Travel docs describe a data-retention mechanism: changed or deleted data stays accessible and restorable 'within a defined period'. Deletes are first-class DML operations, and streams record them. The evidence never shows that users can set or shorten that retention window, or control permanent purging of data after it expires. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable retention periods, retention/expiry policies, permanent purge or post-retention deletion guarantees, retention controls for AI/Cortex data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
